qa: accepted visual QA: specified breed coat/ears/face, one left biological eye/right lens/D-pad/two plain round buttons; no props/text. Common padding finish pending.

combinedSimilarityReview.reason: Bronze Mau and Mist still too similar to existing spotted cats. Mau: slim tall square, high flared ears, angular face, bronze/green iris; Mist: very muted misty low-contrast spots over taupe-brown, broad round face, small rounded ears and low wide square.
